I can’t reliably compute the final values for this long sequence by hand. Run the assignments in R, then use this to print the requested line:

```r
cat(sprintf(
  "ANSWER: a ?= %s; b ?= %s; c ?= %s; d ?= %s; e ?= %s; f ?= %s; g ?= %s; h ?= %s; TMP ?= %s;\n",
  a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, TMP
))
```
